title: NAMD：複本交換的詳細平衡與隨機接受證據
titleEn: NAMD: replica-exchange detailed balance and acceptance evidence
subcategoryTitle: 分子、電子結構與粒子科學計算
summary: 使用原創合成資料研究「NAMD：複本交換的詳細平衡與隨機接受證據」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付權重推導、兩組接受事件、隨機種子與交換前後狀態對照表。
summaryEn: Investigate NAMD: replica-exchange detailed balance and acceptance evidence using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver the weight-ratio derivation, both acceptance events, random-stream identifiers and a before-and-after replica-state table that separates temperature labels from physical configurations.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

options: 接受率異常可能是 β 差號誌反轉、能量與複本編號錯配或亂數重用；單看交換次數無法判斷詳細平衡。
接受交換實作前須驗證權重比、邊界機率與複本標籤；真實 MD 交換另需正確處理速度與溫控，並檢查平衡化、往返與相關性；本式不含 NPT 額外項。
溫度複本交換可改善採樣，但接受率很高不代表取樣正確；本課重建兩複本交換的機率與可追溯事件。
optionsEn: Suspicious acceptance may arise from a reversed beta difference, mismatched replica-energy identifiers or unintended random-stream reuse. Counting accepted swaps cannot distinguish these failures or certify detailed balance.

Accept the exchange implementation only after weight ratios, limiting probabilities and replica labels pass. Actual MD exchange also needs correct velocity and thermostat handling, equilibration, round-trip diagnostics and correlation analysis; this formula excludes additional NPT terms.
Replica exchange can help sampling, but a high acceptance rate alone does not establish a correct ensemble. Reconstruct a two-replica exchange probability and its auditable random decision.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「案例與來源邊界」。溫度複本交換可改善採樣，但接受率很高不代表取樣正確；本課重建兩複本交換的機率與可追溯事件。 與本階段判準一起判讀：交換比的指數為 (β1−β2)(E1−E2)，正負號可追溯。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies case and source boundary. Replica exchange can help sampling, but a high acceptance rate alone does not establish a correct ensemble. Reconstruct a two-replica exchange probability and its auditable random decision. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: The ratio exponent is (beta1-beta2)(E1-E2), with each sign traceable to its original term.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: 溫度複本交換可改善採樣，但接受率很高不代表取樣正確；本課重建兩複本交換的機率與可追溯事件。
knowledge.textEn: Replica exchange can help sampling, but a high acceptance rate alone does not establish a correct ensemble. Reconstruct a two-replica exchange probability and its auditable random decision.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 使用原創合成資料研究「NAMD：複本交換的詳細平衡與隨機接受證據」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付權重推導、兩組接受事件、隨機種子與交換前後狀態對照表。
knowledge.textEn: Investigate NAMD: replica-exchange detailed balance and acceptance evidence using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver the weight-ratio derivation, both acceptance events, random-stream identifiers and a before-and-after replica-state table that separates temperature labels from physical configurations.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 交換前後的 Boltzmann 權重比為 exp((β1−β2)(E1−E2))，接受率取其與一的較小者；β 是反溫度。
knowledge.textEn: The swap-to-original Boltzmann weight ratio is exp((beta1-beta2)(E1-E2)). Metropolis acceptance is the smaller of that ratio and one, with beta representing inverse temperature in consistent energy units.

stages.title: 建立聯合分布
stages.description: 分別寫 exp(−β1E1−β2E2) 與交換後權重；先約掉共同正規化常數，再化簡差值，避免背公式。
stages.descriptionEn: Write the original and swapped joint weights explicitly. Cancel their common normalization factors before simplifying the exponent, and label the configuration associated with each energy so that temperature labels cannot silently exchange twice.
